admin-link-desc: Post a weekly sample and run the voting.
admin-page-desc: Post a sample and a window; members submit flips and vote.
admin-sample: Sample audio (WAV or MP3, up to 8 MB)
challenge-none: No sample flip is running yet. Check back soon.
embed-hint: Readers press Run to see it. It runs in a sandbox with no network access and never runs by itself.
entry-file: Audio bounce (WAV or MP3, up to 8 MB)
jam-intro: Edit one project with up to 3 friends. MIDI and pattern tracks are shared; audio recordings stay on your device.
jam-join-hint: Or join with a room code. Your open project is saved to your library first.
jam-lock-hint: Editing a track locks it for you until you pause for a few seconds.
jam-start: Start a jam from this project
radio-desc: Always on. Take the decks in the DJ rotation or just listen and vote.
radio-dj-hint: DJs queue one track per turn.
radio-pick: Search and pick a track for your turn.
radio-queued: Your track is queued. Search to swap it.
radio-silent: The decks are empty. Join the rotation and queue a track.
vote-done: You voted. Results appear when voting ends.
vote-hint: Listen, then vote for your favourite. One vote each.
